summary: Ignacio buys the last nine pounds of hair-rope in Cadiz and signs Fausto's bond, whose third clause requires a living specimen before the financier's witnesses; Fausto announces he is sailing with the ship.

states.c1: under bond, provisioned, sixty-one days to deliver
states.c4: aboard as owner of the voyage, holding the bond

facts: nine pounds of hair-rope bought, 120 feet
bond clause three: a living specimen, whole and breathing
sixty-one days before forfeit
Fausto has seen four dead specimens in twenty years, paid for two

summary: Brites makes Ignacio tell the boy the Restinga story straight: a night and a day held up from behind, an arm with a tear from wrist to elbow, and four witnesses in the Sanlucar boat who afterwards gave four different accounts.

states.c1: has said the story out loud for the first time in years
states.c2: has what she asked for and likes it less
states.c5: has stopped treating the hunt as a story

facts: Ignacio was twenty; eleven years ago
he cannot swim
the mark is a tear from wrist to elbow on the left forearm
four men in the Sanlucar boat, four accounts, one now a priest in Jerez
the shoal is raised on the nineteenth, the anniversary to the day

summary: On the nineteenth, over the shoal, Pau feels the song in the bone and not the ear; the argument about whether she exists ends and Ignacio puts both boats down. Brites cuts off her plait for rope.

states.c1: no longer the only believer aboard; committed to the hunt
states.c2: has given her hair and will not say why she is afraid
states.c5: has felt it and is ashamed of having doubted

facts: the shoal lies two fathoms under with the bottom visible
black ribs of an unnamed wreck on the sand
Brites had worn the plait fifteen years

summary: The first cast fails: inside the song the boats come off the line, Brites goes over the side and is hauled back after eleven seconds, and cannot say what she saw.

states.c1: first method proved, first cast lost
states.c2: has been in the water with it and is rule four's newest example
states.c5: steering the line in the first boat

facts: method: two boats a hundred feet apart, leaded hair-rope between
Brites eleven seconds under, surfaced on the far side of the boat
rule four holds even at arm's length

summary: The second cast holds. In the bottom of the boat Ignacio sees the eleven-year-old tear on her left forearm and knows the catch is the one who saved him; he orders her into the tank and Fausto turns the glass.

states.c1: captor of his own creditor; giving orders and not looking at her
states.c2: lashing the boats' crews by the belt; watching the captain
states.c3: taken, three turns of hair-rope at the waist, in the lead tank

facts: three turns of hair-rope held her; rule five confirmed
her left forearm carries the same healed tear
the grey comes into her skin within the hour out of the sea
the glass is turned from the moment she left the water

summary: Six days in the tank: the chalk tally on the beam runs the length of the frame, her singing thins at thirty turns, is rare at a hundred and is gone by two hundred and forty. Pau asks who the proving is for and gets no answer.

states.c1: has come no further than the ladder since the fifth day
states.c3: voice spent to breath; two hundred and forty turns counted
states.c5: changing the water eleven times a day; has asked the question

facts: tally chalked on the beam, five and a gate to a turn
sang at thirty turns, seldom at a hundred, silent by two hundred and forty
seawater in the lead tank goes stale in a day

summary: Fausto sets course for the Guadalquivir and a hall behind the Lonja with eleven seated witnesses; Brites names rule seven and rule four against it and asks for an order. Ignacio gives none. The bar is raised at first light.

states.c1: silent under a direct request for an order
states.c2: has stated the price and been refused an answer
states.c4: course set for the river on the authority of the bond

facts: hall behind the Lonja, held since March, eleven witnesses, four of them court-worthy
four days to the bar, two days up the river
no mermaid has crossed the bar alive (r7)

summary: At the bar Brites refuses the helm and Fausto steers himself; Ignacio hands back the bond intact, gives up the proof rather than the debt, and puts the ship about for the shoal.

states.c1: has abandoned proof; ship turned southwest by west
states.c2: has refused the last order and been vindicated
states.c4: holds the bond and the ship in seventeen days

facts: bond returned untorn; seventeen days left on it at the bar
course southwest by west, four days back to the Restinga

summary: In a glass calm over the shoal Ignacio cuts the hair-rope himself and puts her over the side. She goes down without a sound, the shoal is bright and empty, and there is nothing left to show it happened.

states.c1: debt paid, hands on the knife, no evidence of any kind
states.c2: stood off and let him do it

facts: released in a glass calm, two fathoms, over the same shoal
the hair-rope parted at the second draw
the cut ends given to Pau

summary: La Alondra comes into Cadiz with an empty hold and a forfeit bond; the town settles on eleven years and nothing to show, Fausto sells the ship, and Ignacio counts three hundred and eleven days to an anniversary he will not attend and no longer needs to.

states.c1: ashore, shipless, unbelieved, and done needing to be believed
states.c2: first mate in a Genoa trader, plait grown back
states.c5: keeps the cut rope in a tin box for sixty years

facts: bond forfeit by seven days; a fortnight becalmed off Trafalgar on the way home
Fausto sold the ship to a fisherman; the hall let to a glass seller
three hundred and eleven days to the anniversary (r6)

reason: Continuity audit (FR-39): the bond term in the fact ledger did not close. Signed for sixty-one days on page 1, the ledger carried fifty-three days remaining at the bar and a forfeit by twenty-one days at Cadiz, which cannot both follow from the same voyage.
resolution: Seventeen days remaining at the bar; a fortnight becalmed off Trafalgar on the passage home; the ship comes in seven days past the bond. Pages 08 and 10, digest 03 and the affected fact records amended.
